backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the FruitVerse game backend, handling user registration/login, session management, booster inventory, leaderboard, badges, themes, audio file storage, and admin operations with access control mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that the app-ads.txt file is served at the root URL path with the required Google AdSense publisher line.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose, covering components, pages, hooks, contexts, and ad-related files in the FruitVerse application.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML entry point for the React app, mounting the app into a div with id 'root' and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/public/app-ads.txt: Plain-text ads.txt file containing a single Google AdSense DIRECT entry for publisher ID pub-7936595519986908.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing routing between login, game, and admin pages using state and browser history, wrapped with QueryClient, LanguageProvider, and ThemeProvider.
frontend/src/components/ads/Interstitial: Triggers a native Android interstitial ad via the AndroidBridge JavaScript bridge and calls onClose when the ad is dismissed.
frontend/src/components/ads/RewardedAd.t: Triggers a native Android rewarded ad via AndroidBridge and handles reward, close, and failure events, invoking the appropriate callbacks and showing toasts.
frontend/src/components/BadgeDisplay.tsx: Displays the highest-tier player badge (novice, rookie, advanced, master) as an image with a tooltip, supporting three size variants.
frontend/src/components/BoosterPanel.tsx: Compact UI panel showing three booster types (bomb, nextFruitChange, alignment) with counts, activation buttons, and active-state highlighting.
frontend/src/components/FruitAnimation.t: Canvas-based background animation that renders floating, rotating fruit images chosen by the active visual theme (tropical, berry, or citrus).
frontend/src/components/FruitMergeGame.t: Core game component implementing a fruit-merging physics game on an HTML canvas, supporting multiple game modes (normal, puzzle, etc.), boosters, sound effects, and score submission.
frontend/src/components/HealthMonitor.ts: Displays a card showing the backend health status (healthy/error/disconnected) with the last check timestamp, polling via a React Query hook.
frontend/src/components/LanguageSwitcher: Dropdown menu component that lets users switch the app's display language from the list of supported languages.
frontend/src/components/Leaderboard.tsx: Renders a leaderboard card showing the top 10 players and the current user's rank, with trophy icons and reward text for the top 3 positions.
frontend/src/components/ThemeSwitcher.ts: Dropdown menu component that allows users to switch between visual themes (tropical, berry, citrus) using the ThemeContext.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: React context provider that manages the app's active language, persists it to localStorage, sets the HTML document's lang/dir attributes, and exposes a translation function.
frontend/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx: React context provider that manages and persists the selected visual theme (tropical, berry, or citrus) to localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, using an authenticated identity when available and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFruitAudio.ts: Custom React hook that loads MP3 audio files from blob storage and provides functions to play game sound effects and background music, with persistent music toggle state stored in localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and identity state with status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend actor interactions including user registration/login, booster inventory management, score submission, and audio metadata retrieval.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet using Tailwind CSS that defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes and utility classes for game UI components like the game board, header, boosters, and cards.
frontend/src/index.html: HTML entry point for the FruitVerse app that mounts the React root element and includes a Google AdSense script tag.
frontend/src/lib/i18n.ts: Internationalization module supporting 10 languages (including Turkish, English, German, etc.) with a translations map and utility functions for looking up and interpolating translation strings.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that renders the app wrapped in QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider providers.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page with authentication, tabs for managing audio files, top players, and backend health status. Supports uploading audio from URLs and viewing/deleting leaderboard entries.
frontend/src/pages/GamePage.tsx: Main game page that shows mode selection first, then renders the FruitMergeGame with a header containing booster controls, leaderboard dialog, and health monitor dialog.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login/registration page with tabbed forms for user sign-up and sign-in, input validation, themed background, and animated fruit decorations.
frontend/src/pages/ModeSelectionPage.tsx: Game mode selection page displaying four modes (normal, speed, puzzle, endless) as clickable cards with icons, descriptions, and themed background.
frontend/src/types/android-bridge.d.ts: TypeScript declaration file extending the Window interface with optional AndroidBridge (ads) and AndroidAudio (sound playback) native bridge objects.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL query parameters from both standard and hash-based routing, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based colors, border radii, accordion animations, and enabling typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of the FruitMatch Android project, recording that the pending task is to add an app-ads.txt endpoint at the app's root URL to satisfy Google AdMob verification requirements.
